content.text:
April 15th, 2025
Glass Room

Present: Ann, Elliot, Quinton, Mrs. Haider, Owen, Ms. Boland, James, Frankie, Hugo
Absent: Evangeline, Sheree

Welcome! Congrats!
Shared what everyone’s excited about for VYMUN 2025!
Theme for VYMUN Sr. and Jr?
Metamorphosis/Change - Quinton
A new chapter/horizons - Mrs Haider
VYMUN new generation - Mrs Boland
Fight for democracy - Mrs Boland
Voice/Positive Discussion/Productive Discourse - Mrs Haider
The Room where it happens/presence
Contribution - Ann
Financials (Mrs. Haider)
Larger budget this year - may influence price for delegates
We do not buy anything ourselves, go through Mrs Boland/Mrs Haider
Let them know if you have ideas
Secretariat Roles & Job Descriptions.
Secretariat Job Descriptions VYMUN 2025
Feedback/questions about roles and responsibilities
Weekly Zoom meeting schedule
Definitely Not: Friday(Haider and Boland), Monday (Frankie), Thursday (Quinton)
Tuesday at 7PM
Backup: Thursday at 7PM
Start April 28th
Conference: (24th - 26th)
Explore starting earlier on Friday (start at 10-11AM - Sec set up in morning)
Staff hiring:
Process
James has old form, Ann has old poster
Put in DAs
One application for both Sr and Jr
Open Jr up to younger applicants for Chair/AD positions
Experienced MUNers
Write on form more info about Jr and Sr so they are more educated to make a decision
Deadlines
May 2nd - Application Deadline
Advertising: Email to MUN club, DA’s, The Howl


To be Discussed Next TIme:
Media:
Website
Instagram
Action Items:
James Wang Edit the staff application form, put onto DA/Howl
Include USG of Crisis and Media (Rest of crisis/media can be separate)
Frances NakhudaPoll/email teachers if they would be willing to start at 12:00pm/welcome email
Hugo ChungEvangeline Zixuan Linmeet + talk about vymun jr vision (e.g. staffing)
Slide deck to present to Junior School before the end of the school year
Zi Kun MengBrainstorming ideas


Changes:
Some committees may need three topics
